findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 456 requests to 114 third-party domains (median of 3 passes).
Of 23.4 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 6.9 MB (29%) came from third-party domains, 2.7 MB of it from services classified as tracking (298 requests).

64 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: 1rx.io (RhythmOne (Magnite), advertising), 360yield.com (Improve Digital, advertising), 3lift.com (TripleLift, advertising), acuityplatform.com (Acuity Ads, advertising), adform.net (Adform, advertising), adnxs.com (Microsoft (Xandr), advertising), ads.linkedin.com (LinkedIn, advertising), adsrvr.org (The Trade Desk, advertising), adtrafficquality.google (Google, advertising), agkn.com (Neustar (TransUnion), advertising).
190 cookies were set by third-party domains (235 cookies in total).
The main document response did not include a Content-Security-Policy header or meta tag.
